by: claude: tax back-fill 2015 onward, South Africa (report taxes 2015/16 to 2025/26; other taxes 2024/25 and 2025/26)
note: South Africa, tax years 1 March to end February. Capital gains: SARS's own table of the maximum effective rate per year (13.65% in 2015/16, 16.4% in 2016/17, 18% from 2017/18) with the annual exclusion from the PwC copy dated inside each year (EY 2016-17 for 2016/17, when no PwC copy exists). No wealth, solidarity or securities-account tax in any year. Other taxes for the last two closed years from SARS and PwC. Treaty dates for Mauritius and Seychelles from the SARS treaty list and the treaty texts.

jurisdictions.structure_note: All tracked taxes are national and administered by SARS (income tax including capital gains, dividends tax, interest withholding, estate duty). Provinces levy none of them; municipal property rates are local and not tracked. No regions needed.

treaties.note: Signed at Maputo on 17 May 2013, in force 28 May 2015 (SARS treaty list: GG 38862 of 17 Jun 2015); replaces the 1996 treaty. Dividends 5% (qualifying company holdings) or 10%, interest 10%, royalties 5% (synthesised text with the MLI: https://www.sars.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/Legal/Agreements/Legal-INTA-DTA-MLI-2023-14-Mauritius-SA-Synthesised-text-MLI.pdf). MLI in force 1 Feb 2020 for Mauritius and 1 Jan 2023 for South Africa.

Signed at Cape Town on 26 Aug 1998 (treaty text: https://www.sars.gov.za/wp-content/uploads/Legal/Agreements/LAPD-IntA-DTA-2012-14-DTA-Seychelles-GG-25646.pdf), in force 29 Jul 2002 (SARS treaty list, GG 25646 of 30 Oct 2003); protocol in force 15 May 2012 (GG 35396). Treaty WHT rates not read (the text is a scan), so the WHT fields stay empty.
